# laravel_cloud_ip_addresses (Data Source)

Lists Laravel Cloud egress IP addresses for firewall allowlisting.

Use this to allow traffic from Laravel Cloud through a firewall on a service your
application connects to. Set `region` to the region your environment runs in;
omitting it returns the addresses for every region, which is rarely what a
firewall rule wants.

```hcl
data "laravel_cloud_ip_addresses" "cloud" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

resource "aws_security_group_rule" "from_cloud" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 5432
  to_port     = 5432
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = [for ip in data.laravel_cloud_ip_addresses.cloud.ip_addresses : "${ip}/32" if !strcontains(ip, ":")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region` (String) Limit the result to a single region, e.g. "us-east-1". Omit to return the addresses for every region. An unknown region is rejected by the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `ip_addresses` (List of String) Sorted IPv4 addresses and IPv6 CIDR ranges to allowlist. Covers every region unless `region` is set.
